scope_change_reason: PR3879 just supplied standalone endpoint machines but its one-dirty-record in-place route is quadratic. This follow-up changes the storage contract to a larger arbitrary dirty bank, restores it after every streamed chunk and proves a full space-time tradeoff, closing that explicit algorithmic limitation rather than refining a decoder floor.
actual_scope: Explicit two-tape finite-control XOR permutation with restored dirty buffer, exact transition/control/footprint invoices and source-bound P112 application.
bottleneck_link: Residual C_E squared translations must be executed or validly cancelled before the pending port decoder feeds a native consumer. This supplies a faster paid in-place alternative with a concrete changed space assumption.

family_gate.proved_costs: Exact tape transitions, finite state/table inventory, head restoration, touched windows and scratch restoration.
